close: Accessible label of the close (X) button in onboarding dialogs, sheets and the step-1 header.
goBack: Accessible label of the back-arrow button in the onboarding step header (steps 2 and 3).
stepCounter: Step counter in the onboarding dialog header, e.g. "1 of 3". $1 = current step number (rendered as an animated digit, so it is a slot in the markup), $2 = total number of steps. The space after $1 is a no-break space.
skip: Footer button on the survey step that skips the question.
goToHome: Footer button on the last onboarding step (interests). "Home" is the personalized Home page the onboarding sets up.
playAnimation: Accessible label of the welcome globe illustration; tapping it replays the animation.
surveyTitle: Heading (and radio-group label) of the onboarding survey step.
surveyRead: Survey option title: the reader mainly wants to read.
surveyEdit: Survey option title: the reader mainly wants to edit.
surveyBoth: Survey option title: both reading and editing.
interestsTitle: Heading of the interests onboarding step. The reader is asked to pick three topics (Wikipedia articles).
interestsLabel: Visually hidden label of the interests search field.
interestsSearch: Placeholder and accessible label of the interests search field.
noResults: Shown in the interests search menu when nothing matches.
interestsDone: Success message once enough interests have been chosen.
relatedArticles: Heading of the suggestion list under the interests field, when suggestions are related to the chosen interests.
randomArticles: Heading of the suggestion list under the interests field, when suggestions are random (no interests chosen yet).
loadingRelatedArticles: Accessible label of the progress bar while {{msg|onboarding-relatedArticles}} load.
loadingRandomArticles: Accessible label of the progress bar while {{msg|onboarding-randomArticles}} load.
addInterest: Accessible label of a suggested-article card; activating it adds the article as an interest. $1 = article title.
dismiss: Accessible label of the close button on the "return to your Home" banner.
returnHome: Banner shown on articles after onboarding. $1 = the username (rendered in bold), as it appears in the account menu.
search: Accessible label of the search button in the article header.
loadingArticle: Accessible label of the progress bar while an article loads.
articleLoadError: Error shown when an article fails to load. $1 = technical error detail (e.g. "HTTP 404 Not Found"), not translated.
savePagesTitle: Title of the sheet shown to logged-out readers who tap the bookmark button on an article.
done: Default label of the primary button in the header of full-screen dialogs.
